entries.rationale: Four published official m5-atmbench TCP runs since 2026-09-08 all measured below the 17000 floor (20260908T045049Z p50 16564.46, 20260914T200908Z 16227.39, 20260915T024509Z 16331.34, 20260923T212808Z 16587.75) while sqlite, UDS and TCP+TLS kept passing; the last pass was 20260906T194537Z at 18694.42. Rand sign-off 2026-09-23 UTC: 'we should lower the tcp floor so these pass moving forward.' 16000 sits below the observed four-run range with a 1.4% margin under its minimum.
Three-run m5-atmbench dataset (20260825T045840Z, 20260826T001441Z, 20260826T002410Z) and Rand sign-off; the original TCP+TLS floor was mis-seeded equal to TCP and had never been achieved.
